steps.title: Session creation
steps.note: createSession builds a BrowserSession with a generated id, viewport, and status. ToolResult wraps success, data, and metadata so failures can be handled gracefully.

steps.title: Safe navigation
steps.note: navigate validates the URL against isUrlAllowed before loading the page. Blocked URLs return a ToolResult error instead of throwing, keeping the Cowork loop stable.

steps.title: Tool registry
steps.note: browserControlTools maps stable tool names to functions. Cowork and OperatorBrowserView use these names to invoke session, navigation, screenshot, and viewport actions.
